mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, species, breed, gender, color, birth_date, neutered, weight, photo_url, medical_notes, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM pets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'normal' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'normal' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, user_id, name, species, breed, gender, color, birth_date, neutered, weight, photo_url, medical_notes, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM pets WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'normal' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets ( user_id, name, species, breed, gender, color, birth_date, neutered, weight, photo_url, medical_notes, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{color}, #{birthDate}, #{neutered}, #{weight}, #{photoUrl}, #{medicalNotes}, 'normal' )
mapper.update: UPDATE pets SET name = #{name}, species = #{species}, breed = #{breed}, gender = #{gender}, color = #{color}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, neutered = #{neutered}, weight = #{weight}, photo_url = #{photoUrl}, medical_notes = #{medicalNotes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'normal' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE pets SET status = 'deleted', deleted_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
